# Honest Vacation Marketing

> Vacation certificate offers with every cost printed before you give your name.
> A brand of Elite Marketing Solutions LLC, Santa Barbara CA.

## What this is
Four vacation certificate offers provided by Gateways Unlimited and fulfilled by
Customer Service Network Group (CSNG). To receive a certificate you attend one live 45-60 minute online
presentation. There is no charge to attend and you keep the certificate either way.

## Who qualifies
A couple attending together, both aged 35-72, household income over $75,000,
holding a major credit card, and who have not attended a vacation-ownership
presentation in the last 90 days.

## The offers
- **Cruise Getaway for Two** ($464 out the door for two: nothing today, $150 refundable deposit at save-the-date, $314 remainder at booking) — Sail 3, 4 or 5 nights from a port near you. Interior stateroom for two, ongoing member travel benefits after. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/cruise.html
- **All-Inclusive Beach Escape** ($836 out the door for two: nothing today, $298 refundable deposit at save-the-date, $538 remainder at booking) — Cancún, Dominican Republic or Montego Bay. Meals and drinks genuinely included — we print what "included" means. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/all-inclusive.html
- **Resort Stay + Airfare Credit** ($540 out the door for two: nothing today, $240 refundable deposit at save-the-date, $300 remainder at booking) — Cabo, Costa Rica, Honolulu, San Juan or Cancún — resort accommodations plus a $500 airfare credit in one plan. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/resort-air.html
- **Full Condo Week** ($360 out the door for two: nothing today, $150 refundable deposit at save-the-date, $210 remainder at booking) — A whole week with a kitchen and room to spread out. 60+ destinations across the US, Canada, Caribbean and Mexico. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/condo.html

## When money is due
Nothing is charged when you sign up or when you attend. The refundable deposit is
paid at save-the-date, when travel dates are locked in; the balance — taxes, port,
resort and agency fees — is paid at booking. Deposit plus balance is the
out-the-door total shown above.

## The operating rule
Everything upfront, everything optional. Every offer page prints its taxes, fees,
refundable deposit and the sourced market price being beaten, above the signup form,
along with every restriction. Prices researched August 4, 2026.

## Certificate destinations
Forty destination pages, one per place a certificate can take you, each printing the traveler-paid charges, deposit mechanics, and availability rules before anything else. Index: https://honestvacationmarketing.com/certificates/
- **Resort Condominium** (20 destinations) — https://honestvacationmarketing.com/certificates/index.html#condo
- **All-Inclusive** (3 destinations) — https://honestvacationmarketing.com/certificates/index.html#all-inclusive
- **Cruise** (12 ports and regions) — https://honestvacationmarketing.com/certificates/index.html#cruise
- **Stay + $500 Airfare Credit** (5 destinations) — https://honestvacationmarketing.com/certificates/index.html#airfare
Certificate terms: https://honestvacationmarketing.com/certificates/terms.html

## Every certificate, by destination

Each page prints the traveler-paid charges, the refundable deposit, what is included and
excluded, the travel window, and the qualification criteria — before any name is collected.
Nothing is collected at the presentation itself.
